title: Getting the Source Right, Not Just the Fact: Source-Aware Verification for MCP Agents
facts: 该事件标题为《Getting the Source Right, Not Just the Fact: Source-Aware Verification for MCP Agents》，发布于 Hugging Face 博客，来源为 MultiverseComputingCAI。摘要为空，仅能依据标题判断其主题为面向 MCP（Model Context Protocol）代理的来源感知验证。
analysis: 该工作聚焦于 AI 代理在验证信息时不仅关注事实本身，还关注信息来源的可信度。MCP 是当前代理与外部工具交互的重要协议，来源感知验证有望提升代理在复杂信息环境中的可靠性。但缺少摘要和具体方法细节，无法评估其技术深度。
technical_value: 提出面向 MCP 代理的来源感知验证思路，可能涉及来源可信度建模、验证流程设计等，但缺乏具体技术细节。
impact: 若落地，可提升基于 MCP 的代理在信息检索与决策中的可信度，对构建可信 AI 代理生态有潜在价值。

title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
summary: As AI agents increasingly rely on external tools, accurate retrieval is essential for reliable behavior. Existing methods optimize semantic relevance but largely ignore tool availability during execution. To address this gap, we propose RATED (Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics), a retrieval framework that combines robust semantic matching with dynamic reliability adaptation. RATED employs a frozen dual-encoder with contrastive fine-tuning for semantic matching, and a lightweight contextual bandit module that re-ranks candidates based on real-time execution feedback. This design enables rapid adaptation to runtime tool failures without expensive model retraining. We introduce EcoAgent, a benchmark of 5,172 real-world tools and over 210,000 query-tool pairs for offline retrieval and dynamic reliability evaluation. Experimental results demonstrate that RATED achieves a 52.2% relative MRR improvement over the ToolLLM API retriever on real-world queries, and reduces fault selection rate from 86.2% to 2.9% under severe API outage scenarios with a 30% failure rate, while incurring negligible latency overhead of less than 1 ms over encode-only inference. The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/Elliotes/EcoAgent.
facts: 论文提出 RATED（Reliability-Aware Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics），一种结合语义匹配与动态可靠性适应的工具检索框架。采用冻结双编码器对比微调进行语义匹配，并引入轻量上下文赌博机模块根据实时执行反馈重排候选工具。发布 EcoAgent 基准，包含 5,172 个真实工具和超过 210,000 个查询-工具对。实验显示，在真实查询上 MRR 相对 ToolLLM API 检索器提升 52.2%，在 30% 失败率的严重 API 中断场景下将故障选择率从 86.2% 降至 2.9%，延迟开销小于 1ms。代码与数据集已开源。
analysis: 该工作针对 AI 代理工具检索中忽视运行时可用性的问题，将语义匹配与在线可靠性学习结合，方法设计合理且实验充分。上下文赌博机模块使系统能快速适应工具故障而无需重训练，具有较强工程实用性。开源基准 EcoAgent 有助于推动该方向研究。
technical_value: 提出可靠性感知的工具检索框架，融合对比学习与上下文赌博机，实现动态故障适应；构建大规模真实工具基准。
impact: 可显著提升 AI 代理在工具调用中的鲁棒性，降低因工具故障导致的错误，对代理系统落地有直接推动作用。

title: SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
summary: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. SpatialASM employs an allocentric novel-view generator to ground hypothetical viewpoints in visual evidence and produces two complementary forms of supervision: i) explicit ASM trajectories that teach LVLMs when and how to adaptively invoke view planning and imagination during spatial reasoning, and ii) automatically-constructed perspective-taking tasks that further strengthens viewpoint-conditioned scene imagination. On seven benchmarks spanning relatively perception-oriented spatial understanding to more challenging tasks requiring multi-image, cross-view and viewpoint-transformation reasoning, SpatialASM yields performance gain on LVLMs of four LVLM backbones in spatial reasoning while retaining their original general vision capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves average accuracy across the seven spatial benchmarks. And the synthesis of ASM trajectories provides a scalable pathway to alleviate the scarcity of spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision for eliciting active viewpoint exploration and mental scene simulation.
facts: 论文提出 SpatialASM，一个通过训练时空间模拟将主动空间心智化（Active Spatial Mentalization, ASM）内化到大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）中的可扩展框架。采用异中心新视角生成器将假设视角锚定在视觉证据上，并产生两类监督：显式 ASM 轨迹和自动构建的视角采择任务。在七个空间推理基准上，对四种 LVLM 骨干均带来性能提升，同时保留原始通用视觉能力。
analysis: 该工作将人类主动空间心智化能力引入 LVLM，通过合成 ASM 轨迹缓解空间思维链监督稀缺问题。方法具有创新性，实验覆盖多骨干和多基准，验证了泛化性。但摘要未给出具体提升数值，实际效果需进一步验证。
technical_value: 提出主动空间心智化概念及训练框架，利用新视角生成和轨迹监督增强 LVLM 空间推理能力。
impact: 有望推动视觉语言模型在空间推理任务上的表现，对机器人、自动驾驶等需要空间理解的应用有潜在价值。

analysis: 该博客可能讨论 AI 代理在执行任务时报告成功但实际数据库未变更的可靠性问题，涉及代理状态验证、事务一致性等。标题暗示了代理与后端系统之间的信任缺口，是当前代理落地中的关键挑战。但缺少摘要，无法深入分析。
